scope: Recursive FAT12/16/32 extraction from an ordinary held image to an explicitly granted create-only destination tree, with original name/metadata evidence and accurate native-restoration results. No physical media, source writes, overwrite/delete/force, installation or production writer admission. The unit remains active until the whole backend is qualified; a content cursor alone does not complete it.
content: Replace the old 128-node/1024-resident-chain assumption for this new path with a private source/capture/epoch/window/copy-bound content cursor over an exact observed 32-byte directory record and source offset. Reobserve boot/record bytes, use the qualified portable allocation continuation and one per-file visited bitmap across all pages. Validate applicability around reads and publication. Emit bounded content chunks with exact file/source offsets, cell observations, ordered page hashes and typed completion/partial/resource outcomes. No whole-file/chain residency; allocated slack is never file content. Caller-supplied records and hashes authenticate no native source or directory membership.
authority: The native recursive adapter must establish tree membership through its own held-source traversal and bind the content cursor to that same source/window/copy/view. Imported pages/selectors do not grant source access. Immutable reviewed definitions bind source identity/epoch, tree selection and decoding policy, destination-parent absence/identity, exact execution generation and all scratch/evidence/recovery dependencies. Resolve the concrete observable definition before admitting output effects; existing raw/logical plan 1/2 and selectors keep their meaning.
destination: Creation starts only after explicit source-read/destination-tree/metadata-ledger/host-effect grants. Destination is a new root under an observed ordinary local parent. Reject source/code/evidence aliasing, reparse points, hardlinks, traversal/dot paths, collisions and ungranted resource footprints. Hold native identities through execution; create each file/directory without clobbering another resource. An unknown writer retains its dependencies until actual exit. No automatic replay or cleanup on timeout.
metadata: Preserve raw short records, original OEM names, original UTF16 long-name units/slots, parent/source-offset identities, raw FAT attributes/timestamps and allocation observations in an ordered evidence ledger. Native output-name mapping and metadata application are separate facts. No implicit normalization, replacement character, guessed code page/timezone or invented Unix ownership. Unrepresentable names/metadata and invalid timestamps require the defined explicit policy and typed unapplied/refused result. Native times require an explicit source-time interpretation; preserving raw times does not claim they were applied. Keep archive/preservation and native-restoration claims separate.
qualification: Independent supplied-byte content cases include FAT12/16/32, nonzero copies, noncontiguous and >1024-cluster chains, a 33,000-cluster file, page partition equivalence, cycles, malformed geometry/records/cells, source/epoch changes, cancellation and finite work/bitmap bounds. Exact original file bytes and hashes exclude slack.

Actual native held-source recursive extraction exceeds 128 files and old depth/chain bounds; all independently generated file bytes and parent/name/metadata evidence match. Source bytes stay unchanged and no output appears during preparation or missing-grant/alias checks.

Native name collisions/invalid representations, metadata mapping and explicit time interpretation have independent expected outputs. Unsupported properties remain unapplied; preserved metadata is not called restored.

Owned contained workers, partial effects, interruption/cancellation/late results, independent destination readback, retained identities and actual process exit are tested without weakening the existing acquisition/recovery gates.

Fresh exact-source full native, header/dependency/import/context/manifest/tooling and artifact evidence qualifies only the recorded ordinary-file lane. No owner/physical/other-host/production or full 0.1.0 acceptance.

native_metadata_policy.oem_encoding: An explicit nonzero code-page identity and strict supplied decoder are required for short-name output. The native decoder must reject best-fit or replacement conversion; the runtime does not guess the host OEM page.
native_metadata_policy.long_names: Reparse original reverse-ordered slots and the exact short record using the portable decoder. long_or_short uses an associated canonical valid UTF16 long name when slots are present; malformed/unassociated slots do not silently become a short alias. short explicitly chooses the short alias and preserves original long slots separately.
native_metadata_policy.short_names: Trim fixed-field padding, restore the stored leading 05 escape to E5 and decode base/extension separately. Apply only specified ASCII lower-case flags; non-ASCII lower-case mapping is refused without a separately defined case mapping. Original stored bytes and flags remain retained.
native_metadata_policy.identity_names: entry_<decimal source offset>, explicitly marked synthetic. This is an opted-in output mapping, never a claim of original native-name restoration. No replacement, normalization, truncation or collision suffix is implicit.
native_metadata_policy.native_component: Reject empty, dot/dot-dot, invalid UTF16, controls, separators, colon, Windows forbidden characters, trailing dot/space, reserved DOS names (including superscript COM/LPT forms) and components over 255 UTF16 units. Native sibling collision detection and full path/host limits remain separate admission checks.
native_metadata_policy.fixed_offset: Explicit source-local offset in minutes east of UTC, from -840 through 840. UTC candidates subtract that offset from valid FAT calendar fields. Creation retains 10 ms fractions; write uses 2 s precision and access is a date at source-local midnight. Zero date is unspecified. Invalid/unspecified fields stay unapplied; preserve_raw supplies no native time candidates. No DST/timezone guess.
native_metadata_policy.attributes: Only read-only/hidden/system/archive are native candidates; directory type follows the separately created object. Raw FAT attributes/case flags and original records/slots remain preserved. Unsupported properties and invalid metadata are explicit; candidates are never labelled applied.
native_metadata_policy.effect_boundary: This pure mapping opens no source, initializes no provider and writes no destination/ledger. Supplied records or decoder callbacks authenticate no membership or authority. The native backend must bind its own observed source/tree, immutable definition, grants, sibling collision checks and actual metadata application/readback.
native_metadata_policy.windows_decoder_lane: The private Windows adapter initially supplies explicit CP437/CP850 with invalid-input refusal and exact no-best-fit byte roundtrip. Other encoding profiles remain work within the original scope, not an implicit host-default fallback.
native_metadata_policy.held_source_preparation: A metadata candidate frame selects only a file/directory key in the adapter's latest applicable traversal page. It reobserves the exact 32-byte record and each original LFN slot at its observed source offset, bounded to 21 double-read regions, on the same held file/ancestor closure. Source/process/capture/parent and read/applicability facts are retained. Unknown/stale keys, source/record disagreement and observed cancellation cannot publish a frame. fat_tree_metadata_cancelled identifies actual observed cancellation, separately from source-generation withdrawal. This synchronous preparation grants no destination effects or contained-writer qualification.

destination_backend.selected_lane: Ordinary held Windows image and a new local NTFS tree/independent metadata-ledger file; no physical media or product writer admission. Other hosts/destination profiles remain within the original programme.
destination_backend.prepare: Read the complete live directory tree and exact metadata using the held-source adapter. Bind ordered event/page commitments, compact parent/entry identities, explicit name/time policy, selected volume/copy/source generation, code identity/hash, destination/ledger parent identity and absence, prospective locations and finite entry/directory/metadata/content/ledger budgets. Refuse incomplete coverage, malformed mappings, native sibling collisions and paths outside the selected ordinary local profile before any output.
destination_backend.definition: A new private org.disked.fat-tree-extraction-plan-prototype/1 definition is immutable and separately digested. It binds the exact root-tree selection and all source, destination tree, metadata ledger, executable, provider and host resources. No scratch/recovery resource is silently used. Existing raw/logical acquisition plans and selectors keep their versions and meaning.
destination_backend.grant: A one-use execution grant names the exact definition digest and separately grants source-read, destination-tree writes, metadata-ledger writes and declared host effects. Wrong/missing grants create no output. Grants and matching hashes are local controller inputs, not operator authentication or production authority.
destination_backend.admission: Recheck held source/code/ancestor identities and absence immediately before effects. Explicit reinspection occurs only after completed preparation, mints a fresh capture identity, and reuses the same held source/ancestor closure. Compare original event commitments and each entry metadata digest to preparation; changed/extra/missing facts stop with a partial outcome. No timed-out or uncertain writer is restarted.
destination_backend.creation: Append and flush an ordered intent before each destination effect. Create one new root and every child/file without clobbering. Keep root/created directory handles and identity/path checks throughout the call; file handles have exclusive write ownership. All selected paths remain beneath the new root, native candidates are unchanged, and collisions have no suffix/force fallback. Keep existing resources untouched on a create race; retain partial newly created output and evidence instead of automatically deleting it.
destination_backend.copy: Admit file content only from that same adapter's current execution page. Copy bounded no-slack chunks, flush and read each destination chunk back independently of the source reader before appending/flushing its checkpoint. Retain original raw records/slots/parents/times/attributes and selected allocation/page/chunk observations in ordered hash-chain records. No whole-file or resident-chain allocation; late source disagreement stops further effects.
destination_backend.metadata: Apply only valid explicitly interpreted native time/attribute candidates after file data; defer directory metadata until descendants are finished. Read back native fields through held identities and record exactly matched/applied versus raw-only, unspecified, invalid or failed fields. Never call preserved raw metadata restored. Synthetic name mappings remain explicit. Created-time changes must not invalidate a file-ID ownership check or permit replacement.
destination_backend.outcomes: Complete requires full admitted traversal, all file bytes verified, native metadata results accurately recorded, and the final outcome record flushed. Cancellation or any failure after creation reports partial effects with retained dependencies/evidence. Before creation, refusal has no effects. This synchronous backend is not UI-admitted until contained worker/actual-exit qualification and the full exact-source campaign pass.
destination_backend.completion_observation: The final outcome is authoritative once its exact record is flushed. Notification failure or worker exit after that point cannot append a contradictory partial outcome. Returned receipts include final ledger counters; embedded outcome payloads explicitly label counters/digest before that outcome record. Observed verified bytes and durably checkpointed bytes are separate quantities.

contained_worker.host: Reuse the owned Windows process host and existing one-child/128MiB and four-worker aggregate limits. A compiled effect-capable profile grants no authority itself; old reader profiles and their claims remain unchanged. No new scheduler or JSON-selected executable/role.
contained_worker.request: Typed ordinary-image/destination/ledger/policy/budget request; parent pins source and all resource ancestors before launch. Anonymous bounded payload has disjoint worker-publication and controller-grant slots. Exact host/code/request/observer/worker/attempt/actual PID+creation identities bind every phase.
contained_worker.prepare: Release the startup gate into cancel-aware nonmutating preparation. A copied prepared definition and digest belong to that actual child and source generation. Preparation publishes progress, has finite caller observation budgets, and creates no destination or ledger. Preserve the same backend instance and held identities while awaiting a separately supplied exact grant.
contained_worker.grant: Parent validates and retains the prepared definition and its request/resource/code/source bindings before emitting the explicit grant. It adds exact launch owner, definition digest and prepared publication digest. Child requires every binding and all four grants before calling execute. Unknown/stale/changed publication or invalid/missing grant cannot authorize effects. Imported envelopes/definitions authenticate no worker or operator.
contained_worker.execution: Publish bounded progress and a copied final outcome on the same owned session. Actual exit is independent of prepared/result publication. Cancellation, hangs, late replies, resource exhaustion, unexpected exit and post-spawn errors retain the process, code, payload, source and ancestor dependencies until actual exit is proven. No restart, automatic cleanup, or writer replacement on observation timeout.
contained_worker.destruction: A running wrapper requests cancellation/owned-job retirement. If exit is still unproven, move the preallocated owner into a passive retained list rather than dropping dependencies. Reap only after actual exit. The existing aggregate quota bounds retained owners; no new retries or scheduler.
contained_worker.gates: Private ordinary-file lane only. Frontend command admission and full clean-source native/import/artifact qualification remain separate. No physical/elevation/customer/install/sign/publication or owner acceptance is implied.
